relevance_note: One of 22 children with undifferentiated autoinflammatory disease treated with anakinra carries LPIN2 variants: Table 1 row '| 1 | LPIN2 | P626S/S203F [8] | Comp. Het | 4 | VIP | Possible Majeed syndrome |'.
method_note: Retrospective cohort of 22 uAID patients; only patient 1 (Table 1, LPIN2, final diagnosis 'Possible Majeed syndrome') is in scope; the other 21 (other genes or no variant) get no rows. Label: Table 1 'Patient identity' column holds bare numbers, but the text uses its own label form 'patient N' (e.g. 'patient 3', 'patients 1, 6, 7, 8, 10, 16, 17 and 19'), so rule 1 gives 'patient 1'. The amino-acid string 'P626S/S203F' was split into two variant rows (P626S, S203F), each quoted from the same row; no transcript, cDNA or 'p.' prefix is printed and nothing was converted; phase/inheritance not reported, zygosity 'Comp. Het' from the row with the table legend. Pathogenicity value '4' is the cell under the column 'Variant pathogenicity class [8]' (class scheme of ref [8], not defined in this paper). The '[8]' next to the variant may mean the variant or patient appeared in ref [8] (Omoyinmi 2017), but the paper does not state that this patient was described earlier, so cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null. n_patients_reported left null: the authors give no count of LPIN2 patients. Elevated CRP and serum amyloid A recorded from baseline values against the normal ranges given in Methods (CRP 0–20 mg/l, SAA 0–10 mg/l). Clinical features are only in Supplementary Table S1, which is not in the Markdown, so all other checklist items are not reported. Inclusion criteria (systemic inflammation required for uAID) not used as evidence. Vital status left not reported (only the three deaths are named). Contradictions in the paper: the Table 1 notes list molecular diagnoses in patients 1, 6, 7, 8, 10, 16, 17 and 19, while the Discussion lists 1, 6, 7, 8, 10, 16, 17 and 18; the text says final diagnoses are in Table 2, but they are in Table 1. Neither affects patient 1. No script transcription of tables; the JSON was assembled by a short script from hand-chosen values.
